summary: T1 iter200 — Verified POS sample-mode (kind chips + over-limit + under-limit) and Meja Cutting waiting-time instrumentation. Backend 10/10 pass (SAMPLE_LIMIT per kind for woven & knit, 400 code, cutting_desk wait_thresholds=120/240, late_count, cut_at+wait_minutes on every to_receive/ready row, longest-wait-first sort, receive→ready transition with 'diterima setelah' delta). Frontend verified end-to-end: PosProductCard quickview → 'Pesanan Sampel' → 'Tambah Sampel' → CheckoutDrawer step-2 shows sample-kind-{pid} panel with standard & hanger chips, sample-over-limit-{pid} appears correctly when switching to hanger at qty>0.5 yd and disappears at ≤0.5 yd hanger / ≤5 yd standard. Meja Cutting UI (?view=sample-orders → sample-tab-desk) correctly renders cutting-late-alert banner (red, '1 potongan menunggu diterima Admin Cutting lebih dari 4 jam.') and 3 cutting-wait-{taskId} badges with data-level='late' (Terlambat · menunggu 5 j 0 mnt), 'warn' (menunggu 3 j 0 mnt), 'ok' (menunggu 1 j 0 mnt); to_receive queue sorted longest-wait first (late→warn→ok); after cutting-receive-{taskId} click the row moves to Ready with level='done' (diterima setelah 3 j 0 mnt). ONE FRONTEND BUG FOUND: in POS CheckoutDrawer the sample-to-retail-{pid} 'Jadikan ecer' button is MISSING because CheckoutDrawer does not pass onToggleSample prop to CheckoutItemCard. The over-limit text is shown but the inline retail-toggle button (required by review request) does not render, and there is also no toggle-sample-{pid} chip in the drawer to flip a line back to retail/ecer.

ui_bugs.issue: sample-to-retail-{pid} 'Jadikan ecer' button (and the parent toggle-sample-{pid} action) are not rendered in the checkout drawer because <CheckoutItemCard> is instantiated without the onToggleSample prop. SampleLineFields guards the retail-toggle link behind `onToggleSample &&`, so when a woven line is 1 yd and the user switches to Hanger (max 0.5 yd), the over-limit copy appears correctly but the required inline 'Jadikan ecer' button described in the review request is absent. Users cannot convert a sample over-limit line back to retail/ecer from the drawer.

Example: add a `toggleSample` fn `const toggleSample = (id) => setCart(cur => cur.map(it => it.product.id===id ? { ...it, is_sample: !it.is_sample, sample_kind: !it.is_sample ? (it.sample_kind||'standard') : it.sample_kind, quantity: !it.is_sample ? clampSampleQty(it.product, it.quantity, it.sample_kind||'standard') : it.quantity } : it));` and pass `onToggleSample={toggleSample}` to <CheckoutItemCard>. Verify sample-to-retail-{pid} renders and clicking it clears is_sample from the line while keeping the quantity. Then rebuild frontend bundle with /app/scripts/rebuild_frontend.sh.

rca of the issue: FE bug: CheckoutDrawer.jsx line 366-384 omits onToggleSample from the <CheckoutItemCard> props. CheckoutItemCard conditionally renders the toggle-sample button `{onToggleSample && (<button data-testid="toggle-sample-{pid}" .../>)}` and passes onToggleSample through to SampleLineFields, which in turn guards the 'Jadikan ecer' link with `{onToggleSample && <button data-testid="sample-to-retail-{pid}" .../>}`. Because the parent never provides the handler, both testids are missing from the DOM even when the sample-over-limit warning is correctly displayed. Backend path is fully correct — a plain regular SO at the over-sample qty (1 yd woven) is accepted (verified by test_regular_retail_at_over_sample_qty_ok).
